_comment: Applied by scripts/init.sh on every run (idempotent). mounts: kv-v2, transit (with keys) or ldap (the LDAP secrets plugin; one mount per directory, see config/policies/directory-admin.hcl.example). consumers: one AppRole each, bound to the secrets subnet; credentials are written to secrets/consumers/<name>/. A policy name refers to config/policies/<name>.hcl. Removing an entry here does not delete it from the store.

mounts.description: Model provider keys (read by the agent engine's model gateway)
